preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and n >= 1 and n <= 30
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 30) representing the number of strings in the list A.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) >= 1 and len(s) <= 100 for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:n+1]])
preconditions.description: Each of the next n lines contains a non-empty string s_i (1 ≤ |s_i| ≤ 100) as an element of list A.
The input consists of exactly n + 1 lines (1 line for n, n lines for strings).

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the count of nonempty contiguous sublists of A that are stable.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= i <= j < n for i in range(n) for j in range(i, n))
postconditions.description: For every nonempty contiguous sublist L = A[i..j] (0 ≤ i ≤ j < n), f(L) is evaluated as 1 if L is stable, else 0.

postconditions.expression: all((lambda L: (lambda is_stable: is_stable(L))(lambda X: all(good_message(X, msg) for msg in generate_messages(X, max_len=sum(len(s) for s in X) * 2))))(A[i:j+1]) == (lambda X: all(good_message(X, msg) for msg in generate_messages(X, max_len=sum(len(s) for s in X) * 2)))(A[i:j+1])) for i in range(n) for j in range(i, n))
postconditions.description: A sublist L = A[i..j] is stable if and only if every message in S_X (the set of all possible concatenations of elements in L) is good. A message is good if, for its k constituent strings, exactly k of its |w1|+...+|wk| cyclic shifts are in S_X.

postconditions.expression: (lambda X: any(len(X) == 0 for X in [A[i:j+1] for i in range(n) for j in range(i, n)])) == False
postconditions.description: All considered sublists are nonempty (as per task requirement).
